chunks: A number of our companions, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Al-Husayn ibn Saeed, from Al-Nadr ibn Suweyd, from Jarrah Al-Madainy, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:
He should eat on the day of Al-Fitr before he prays, and he should not eat on the day of Al-Azha until the Imam finishes (the prayer).
ai.seo_question: When should one eat on Eid al-Fitr and Eid al-Adha according to Shia jurisprudence?
ai.summary: This hadith from al-Kafi highlights the distinct prophetic practices (Sunnah) for the two Eids, emphasizing gratitude for sustenance on Eid al-Fitr by eating before prayer, and anticipation of the sacrificial offering on Eid al-Adha by delaying food until after the Imam's prayer. Shia jurists often cite this to distinguish the recommended acts (Mustahabb) of each Eid, reflecting the spiritual transition from fasting to feasting in the former and from sacrifice to celebration in the latter.
